concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-add-manage-funds-process-payments-make-a-payment]] — 2026-09-15 Issuing guide for online/Terminal API payments from customers whose revenue can fund issued cards; distinguishes channel-specific setup and amount units, and flags unlabeled split data in its example.
warnings: In-person example titles claim split instructions/success, but the shown request contains no split allocation details; do not infer a configured split or recipient balance account.
